trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: You broke into our headquarters and came straight here? You don't know when to stop!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Fine, fine. Go on up. See if I care.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: The summit is for Team Galactic alone today. Turn round, or be turned round!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: You'll only be in the boss's way up there. Not that he'll notice you.
